_comment: Glossary injected into the translation system prompt by scripts/translate.mjs. Keep DO-NOT-TRANSLATE terms verbatim in every locale. ICU placeholders ({name}) and rich-text tags (<accent>...</accent>) are preserved exactly by the script's validator — never translate the contents inside braces or tag names.
rules: Keep every term in the do-not-translate list EXACTLY as written, in English, even when surrounded by translated text. These are proper nouns, protocol names, or technical identifiers.
Keep any standards code matching the pattern ERC-#### verbatim (e.g. ERC-7857, ERC-8004).
Keep verdict / enum labels verbatim and uppercase: TRUE, FALSE, UNDETERMINED, PARTY_A, PARTY_B.
Keep all hex color codes (e.g. #DC2626), URLs, email addresses, file paths, and dimension/format strings (e.g. '1200 × 630', '24 × 24 · SVG') unchanged.
Preserve ICU placeholders written as {name} EXACTLY — do not translate, rename, reorder the braces, or add spaces inside them. The text inside the braces is a variable name, not content.
Preserve rich-text tags such as <accent>...</accent> EXACTLY — keep the tag names in English and the angle brackets intact. Translate only the human-readable text between the tags.
Produce natural, professional marketing/brand copy for a technical audience. Preserve sentence meaning and tone; do not pad or add explanations. Keep it concise.
Match the source register: confident, clear, no exclamation marks unless present in the source.

localeNotes.es: Neutral, international Spanish (not region-specific). Professional brand register.
localeNotes.ko: Natural Korean suitable for a technical/professional audience. Use appropriate formal-but-modern tone.
localeNotes.zh: Simplified Chinese (zh-CN). Natural, professional brand register.
